description: Take a report or a claim out of the library for good. id is a report (I-?) or a claim (F-?). For a report, what=all (default) removes it and the claims that are its alone, what=report the report only, what=claims its claims only; a claim another report also cites stays and is named. dry=true shows the plan and removes nothing. Files are deleted, the index and the changes log updated; what the run fetched from the web stays. There is no undo ? retire is the gentler thing for a claim.

id.description: A report id (I-?) or a claim id (F-?).

patron.description: Optional: who is asking ? {did, name, runtime}. Anonymous when absent.

what.description: For a report: all (default), report, or claims.

name: library_remove
